verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents batch outbound call campaigns or scheduling. The only related material is account-level concurrency: a reserved inbound concurrency setting that caps outbound calls, a default quota of 20 concurrent calls, and outbound IVR digit pressing. These are adjacent controls, not a campaign feature with scheduling and throughput settings, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
